app.title: FigDiff
app.description: Compare Figma designs with your implementation to detect differences. Enter a Figma URL to get started.

home.heroSub: Compare Figma frames and implementation screenshots pixel by pixel
home.pageDescription: FigDiff compares Figma designs with implementation screenshots pixel-by-pixel and automatically detects differences.
home.inputTitle: Start by entering a URL or image path
home.inputHint: Paste a Figma URL or enter the path to a local image file.
home.inputPlaceholder: Figma URL or local image path...
home.tokenRequired: Please set a Figma Token. You can configure it in Settings.
home.noDesignFound: No design frames were found. Check the URL or your frame structure in Figma.
home.implUrlHint: Both URLs entered → skip frame selection and launch Live Overlay directly.
home.noProjects: No projects yet. Create one to get started.

project.pageDescription: Choose the frame you want to compare from the Figma file and load the design image.
project.nextStep: After selecting a frame, click "Go to Compare Page"

compare.pageDescription: Add an implementation screenshot and detect differences with the Figma design.
compare.title: Design Comparison
compare.designNotLoaded: Enter a Figma URL from Home to load a design
compare.screenshotInstruction: Enter a URL or file path of your implementation
compare.emptyTitle: Load design image to get started
compare.emptyDescription: Return to Home screen, enter a Figma URL, and select a frame.
compare.designLoadedNext: Next, enter a URL or file path of your implementation.
compare.bothLoadedNext: Click "Detect Differences" to run the comparison.
compare.errorBothImagesRequired: Both design image and implementation screenshot are required
compare.suggestionMinor: Minor differences found in {{count}} areas. Use inspect_node to check the diff region nodes.
compare.suggestionMajor: Significant differences found in {{count}} areas. Use inspect_node to review each diff region and apply fixes.

viewMode.desc_transparent_overlay: Overlay design and implementation with adjustable opacity

canvas.hint: Ctrl+Wheel: Zoom | Wheel: Pan | Space+Drag: Pan

settings.title: Settings
settings.pageDescription: Connection settings and behavior options for FigDiff
settings.usePat: Use a Personal Access Token instead
settings.oauthStatusLoadFailed: Failed to load Figma connection status.
settings.thresholdDesc: Values above this threshold are treated as differences.
settings.autoCompareDesc: Automatically run comparison after screenshot capture

tokenDialog.title: Figma Token Required
tokenDialog.description: A Personal Access Token is required to use the Figma API.
tokenDialog.invalid: Please enter a valid Figma Personal Access Token (starts with figd_)

convergence.title: AI convergence record
convergence.unavailable: Convergence records are available in the desktop app only.
convergence.emptyHint: Run compare_design and each iteration's match rate and stop reason will appear here.
